product: miv-cel, mivocabtagene autoleucel, KYV-101, a fully human autologous CD19-targeting CAR T-cell therapy. The 2026-09-24 8-K targets stiff person syndrome, which has no FDA-approved therapy and about 6,000 US diagnosed patients, and generalized myasthenia gravis, about 80,000 US diagnosed. Demand is single-dose drug-free remission replacing chronic immunotherapy.
demand: Not found as revenue. Kyverna is pre-revenue: the 2026-08-11 Q2 2026 report showed no product revenue, net loss 38.3M and R&D 24.8M. Growth is pipeline and regulatory milestones, SPS BLA and gMG Phase 3, not price, volume or mix. Any revenue contribution would first come from the SPS launch guided to 2027.
pricing_power: A class-wide CAR-T safety event. The 2026-09-24 Fierce Biotech piece reported two Big Pharma autoimmune CAR-T peers had safety setbacks; any high-grade CRS or ICANS or IEC-HS case in miv-cel would trigger holds, labeling or a boxed warning, per the 2026-09-01 company statement. Also manufacturing failure, one-time-therapy reimbursement squeeze, and dilution financing at 6.81.
competition: Not found. No dated source read identifies a Chinese or other low-cost substitute approved for SPS or gMG; allogeneic and in-vivo CAR-T remain investigational. The current cheap alternatives are off-label IVIg, rituximab and steroids listed in the 2026-09-24 8-K, but these do not reset the immune system or halt progression.
market_strategy: CEO Warner Biddle, 2026-09-24: the rolling BLA submission is on track to be completed in Q4 2026 and one-year data will be included. 2026-08-11: seek priority review with potential 2027 commercial launch and runway into 2028. 2026-09-01: no safety findings that would lead us to pause or halt any clinical program.
bull: 2026-09-24 8-K: 92% of 26 SPS patients off chronic immunotherapy at 12 months, zero high-grade CRS/ICANS/IEC-HS, rolling BLA on track for Q4 2026, cash 199.4M into 2028.
bear: Pre-revenue, net loss 38.3M, price 6.81 vs 30.4 target; class safety setbacks at two Big Pharma CAR-T peers (2026-09-24 Fierce) and Oxford loan covenants from 2027-06-30.
falsifier: Any reported high-grade CRS, ICANS or IEC-HS case in miv-cel, or the rolling SPS BLA not completed by 2026-12-31.

Growth is pipeline and regulatory milestones, SPS BLA and gMG Phase 3, not price, volume or mix. Any revenue contribution would first come from the SPS launch guided to 2027.
web_bottleneck: Company bottleneck is autologous CAR-T manufacturing scale-up plus FDA approval; 2026-07-27 it signed an ElevateBio clinical and commercial supply agreement with a 98 percent clinical manufacturing success rate. It relieves the bottleneck of no approved SPS disease-modifying therapy, where patients rely on off-label IVIg, rituximab, plasmapheresis and steroids per the 2026-09-24 8-K.
web_who_benefits_next: ElevateBio, the CDMO, gains commercial supply revenue under the 2026-07-27 agreement. Second-order: apheresis and cell-collection providers, cold-chain logistics, and trial sites running KYSA-8 and KYSA-6. Third-order: GAD65 and antibody diagnostics plus neuroimmunology clinics. Patients gain a one-time therapy replacing chronic infusions.
web_who_loses: Incumbent SPS and gMG therapy loses. The 2026-09-24 8-K lists off-label IVIg, rituximab and plasmapheresis as current SPS options, and the same release notes gMG patients had failed FcRn and complement inhibitors; miv-cel kept 92 percent of SPS patients and 86 percent of gMG patients off chronic immunosuppressants.
web_margin_collapse_risk: A class-wide CAR-T safety event. The 2026-09-24 Fierce Biotech piece reported two Big Pharma autoimmune CAR-T peers had safety setbacks; any high-grade CRS or ICANS or IEC-HS case in miv-cel would trigger holds, labeling or a boxed warning, per the 2026-09-01 company statement. Also manufacturing failure, one-time-therapy reimbursement squeeze, and dilution financing at 6.81.
web_low_cost_substitute: Not found. No dated source read identifies a Chinese or other low-cost substitute approved for SPS or gMG; allogeneic and in-vivo CAR-T remain investigational. The current cheap alternatives are off-label IVIg, rituximab and steroids listed in the 2026-09-24 8-K, but these do not reset the immune system or halt progression.
web_ceo_promised: CEO Warner Biddle, 2026-09-24: the rolling BLA submission is on track to be completed in Q4 2026 and one-year data will be included. 2026-08-11: seek priority review with potential 2027 commercial launch and runway into 2028. 2026-09-01: no safety findings that would lead us to pause or halt any clinical program.
web_did_they_deliver: Earlier promises met. The 2026-08-11 release guided 12-month KYSA-8 SPS and longer-term KYSA-6 Phase 2 topline data in Q3 2026; both were delivered 2026-09-24. KYSA-8 topline was delivered 2025-12-15 as scheduled. The rolling SPS BLA remains open: CMC module submitted 2026-08-11 and completion promised Q4 2026.
web_what_would_falsify: Observables: one, the rolling SPS BLA not completed by 2026-12-31; two, any reported high-grade CRS or ICANS or IEC-HS case in miv-cel, which the 2026-09-24 8-K currently reports as zero; three, KYSA-6 Phase 3 gMG enrollment not completed by mid-2027 as guided 2026-09-24; four, FDA requiring an additional trial before accepting the BLA.
